CourseBoy Terms of Use

Effective date: October 31, 2026

These terms set out the conditions for using CourseBoy (the "App"). By downloading or using the App, you agree to these terms and the Privacy Policy.

Apple's Standard End User License Agreement (EULA) also applies to the App downloaded from the App Store. If these terms conflict with the Apple EULA, the Apple EULA prevails.

These terms are provided in Korean, English, Japanese, German, and French. If the language versions differ, the Korean version prevails.

1. The service

The App provides the following features.

  • Importing GPX and TCX course files and showing them as a map, an elevation chart, and a cue sheet
  • Course tracking: telling you your position on the course, the remaining distance, the next course point, and when you leave or rejoin the course, on screen, by voice, and through Live Activities
  • Activity recording, importing and exporting FIT files, and activity backups
  • Creating share images of courses and activities

The App works without signing up, and your courses and activities are stored on your device. The developer may add, change, or remove features.

2. Safe use

  • Do not operate the screen while riding. Stay aware of your surroundings and traffic during cycling, running, and other activities, and stop in a safe place before you look at or operate the App.
  • Follow traffic laws and local rules. Actual road conditions, traffic signals, signs, and access restrictions always take precedence over the App's guidance.
  • Guidance is for reference only. Course files, map data, and GPS and barometer measurements can contain errors. The App does not guarantee that a route is safe or passable, or its current condition (construction, closures, weather, and so on).
  • The App is not designed for emergency response or for decisions where life or safety is at stake.

3. Your responsibilities

  • Course and activity files you import must be files you have the right to use.
  • When you send images and files made with the share feature to others, you decide whether to disclose the location information they contain.
  • Do not reverse engineer or modify the App, or use it in a way that puts excessive load on external services it uses, such as maps.

4. Data and backups

Courses and activities are stored only on your device, and the developer cannot recover them for you. Before changing devices or deleting the App, create a backup with Settings › Activity Backup › Export All Activities and keep it somewhere safe. The developer is not responsible for data lost through device failure, deleting the App, iOS updates, or similar causes.

5. Maps

The App uses Apple Maps (MapKit) to display maps. Copyright in the map data belongs to Apple and its data providers, and sources and legal notices are available from the link at the bottom of the map and in the App under Settings › Map Sources and Licenses. If Apple Maps is discontinued or changes its policies, maps may not be displayed.

6. Intellectual property

The rights to the App and its design, code, and icons belong to the developer. Open source software included in the App is subject to its own licenses. The rights to courses you import and activities you record belong to you.

7. Disclaimer of warranties and limitation of liability

The App is provided "as is". The developer does not warrant that the App will always work without errors, that its guidance and measurements are accurate, or that it is fit for any particular purpose.

To the extent permitted by applicable law, the developer is not liable for any direct or indirect damages, such as accidents, injuries, getting lost, or data loss, arising from the use of or inability to use the App. This does not apply to damages caused by the developer's intent or gross negligence.
